_comment: Spelling dictionaries (Hunspell) offered by the separate language-pack installer. Each entry is fetched from a pinned commit and verified by SHA-256; it is bundled UNMODIFIED with its own license files. To add a language: add an entry, review its license, add the license files under desktop/editors/LICENSES/ (or here), run the language-pack workflow. Interface translations are NOT part of the pack (they are compiled into each editor).
